title: Schematify app dispatcher
description: Handles JSON-RPC method calls for design graph operations.
signature: fn call(app: &AppHandle, context: &CallContext, method: &str, params: Option<Value>) -> Result<Value, RpcError>
semantics: Implements schematify/state, schematify/{open-project,load-graph}, write operations (node, edge, layout, screen, flow, brief, decision), schematify/{transition,reconcile-status,lint,ingest-run,module-dashboard,runs}.
